method.adjusted_family: 13 delta_D comparisons only; nominal 95% Bonferroni family-wise target
method.caveat: Bootstrap coverage is approximate. Relative, auxiliary, block and symmetry intervals are descriptive pointwise 95% only.
method.geometry_comparison: independent samples; no matched event or seed pairing
method.interval_method: whole-event nonparametric percentile bootstrap; pooled 200 events/cell
method.invalid_ratio_policy: undefined point estimates become null; any invalid replicate makes interval null; no dropping/retry
method.joint_resampling: D, G, all births, optical-parent births and energy use identical event indices within each cell
method.rng: NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence(seed).spawn(52)); first 26 children for cells, last 26 for block diagnostics
method.timing: Exploratory analysis specified after scan; not preregistered confirmatory inference
